description: nhentai.xxx, an nhentai mirror on its own engine (bootstrap layout, jQuery Lazy). The gallery block is div.gallery_top > div.gt_left (cover img.lazy, real URL in data-src, a relative /front/images/ld.gif placeholder in src) + div.gt_right > div.info: an h1 with the FULL bracketed title (the title rule has to strip it), p.subtitle with the Japanese title, then div.tags > div.tag_row rows whose label span.tags_text has NO colon ("Parodies", "Tags", "Category"), and entities as ul.tag_list > li > a.tag_btn > span.tag_name + span.tag_count with decimal-K counts ("18.2K", "9.8K"). Below it, ul.g_info puts "Pages: 26" next to "Favorites: 1,987" and shows only a RELATIVE date ("Posted: 2 years ago"), so uploaded_at must be null. Noise that uses the very same /artist/x /tag/x /character/x /group/x URL shapes: the "Related Galleries" cards (each with its own cover, an h2 title, a doujinshi category link and its own artist/group/character/tag links; one is by the same artist), a "Popular Tags" and a "Popular Artists" sidebar, a languages dropdown in the header, JuicyAds zones, and a footer. meta keywords repeats the gallery's own entities. Unsure: this is a reconstruction — I do not remember nhentai.xxx's exact class names or whether it shows an upload date at all; the image CDN (nhentaimg.com with /<server>/<10-char id>/ paths) is from memory.
